quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not independent findings or runtime draws. Direct symmetric/nontransitive judgments require actual labels and ordinary senses, including old secondary senses. Inspect excesses too; no topic/homophone/transitive-closure rule.

足る: sufficiency comparisons and worthiness need separate assessment. Shared 足ります does not establish identical dictionary forms. 段階: phase/level/gradation/order and dictionary stairs comparisons, not a level-topic clique.
短期: short duration compared with adjective/temporary-period uses, not physical shortness. 短所: actual shortcomings/weakness/disadvantage labels, not automatic inability or harm equivalence.

炭鉱: coal mine versus coal product and other minerals. たんす: whole storage furniture versus part 引き出し. 淡水/地下水: water labels can overlap without salinity/source identity; neither means potable. 断水: water-supply suspension, not every outage.

単数: grammatical singular plus general one/single, not alone/oddness merely through English single. 団地: residential complex versus generic housing and apartments; grouped industrial estate is separately public-backed.

断定: categorical judgment/assertion versus ordinary selection. Complete 決める sense5 includes assuming despite old body selecting sense1. Grammatical assertion is not positive polarity. 短編: actual short literary/film work under broad story/film labels.
誓う: solemn promise and vow, not English cursing. 近々: soon and spatial nearness; actual 近く/近い/そろそろ secondary temporal uses matter.
近付ける/近寄る: bring near versus approach; transitivity is not alone decisive for broad English labels. Personal-association extensions need actual evidence; no synonymy merely from 近.

力強い: powerful/vigorous versus reassuring/dependable senses. Inspect actual vigorous mimetics and reliable-person uses, not every health/energy topic. 千切る: actual tearing/plucking and bound intensifier, not every cutting/removal act.
